gh search repos "SEC EDGAR hotel REIT"
gh search repos "hotel occupancy data unit counts"
WebSearch site:github.com hotel REIT RevPAR by market dataset filings (blocked, session web-search budget exhausted)
WebSearch site:github.com marriott hilton hyatt pipeline data csv 10-K (blocked, session web-search budget exhausted)

candidates.name: marriott-hilton-ihg-hotel-data-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: PHP scraper (1 commit, no license) that pulls per-property location, contact info, images, amenities and room/policy details from Marriott, Hilton and IHG US hotel pages. Placeholder /data/hotel_list.txt and room_list.txt only — no scraped data actually committed.
candidates.why_useful: A method (not data) for pulling chain unit-level property lists across the three big chains; could in principle be adapted to build a unit-count census, but it targets amenities/room detail, not RevPAR, pipeline, or loyalty figures, and holds zero committed rows today.

candidates.name: integrated-urban-planning-using-public-transport-and-hotel-industry-data-in-abu-dhabi
candidates.what_it_holds: Auto-generated 'Dataset Publisher AI' repo (MIT license) describing an Abu Dhabi open-data study combining public-transport ridership and hotel-industry occupancy/demand data; no raw file evidently committed in the description surfaced by search, points back to Abu Dhabi DGE open-data portal.
candidates.why_useful: Non-US hotel occupancy/demand series tied to a government open-data portal — a template for finding similar govt-hotel-data portals elsewhere, but Abu Dhabi hotel demand is not a direct ABNB driver market of note; marginal.
candidates.size_hint: unclear, likely a report/notebook not a raw panel

candidates.name: stayapi-agent
candidates.what_it_holds: CLI/API client (StayAPI, commercial service with free tier) that pulls live hotel, vacation-rental and restaurant data from Booking.com, Airbnb, Google Hotels, TripAdvisor and more as JSON.
candidates.why_useful: A live multi-OTA pull tool spanning both hotels and Airbnb-adjacent vacation rentals could be a one-command way to grab current comparator pricing, but it is a paid API wrapper with only a small free quota, not a dataset, and touches airbnb.com directly which the repo rules flag as a human ToS call.
candidates.license: MIT (client code only; underlying API is commercial)

notes: This theme was largely a dead end on GitHub. Ten `gh search repos` queries (hotel REIT RevPAR, hotel loyalty members, Marriott/Hilton pipeline data, SEC EDGAR hotel REIT, hotel occupancy unit counts, hotel industry data, topic=hotel-data, STR/CoStar hotel, hotel scraper) returned either nothing or a long tail of generic OTA review/price scrapers (Booking.com, Agoda, TripAdvisor, Expedia, Traveloka, Fliggy, MakeMyTrip, Hotels.com — mostly Apify-actor wrapper repos from a handful of prolific scraper-publishing accounts, e.g. 'factden', 'stayapi', 'everythingscraper') and single-file Kaggle-style hotel-booking-cancellation notebooks (the Antonio/Almeida/Nunes Portugal dataset re-run repeatedly), none of which touch loyalty program size, chain unit counts/pipelines, or REIT-level RevPAR-by-market. The three specific data types this theme asked for — (1) Marriott/Hilton/Hyatt development pipeline unit counts, (2) loyalty program member counts (Bonvoy/Honors/World of Hyatt), (3) hotel REIT (Host Hotels, Park Hotels, RLJ, Pebblebrook, Sunstone, Apple Hospitality, Ryman, DiamondRock) portfolio RevPAR broken out by market from 10-Ks/10-Qs/investor decks — are disclosed only in SEC filings, investor-day PDFs and press releases; nobody on GitHub appears to have built a structured/committed dataset or scraper specifically for these disclosures (as opposed to the generic sec-edgar-downloader / XBRL-frames tooling that already exists broadly and isn't chain/REIT-specific). Two WebSearch calls to try `site:github.com` variants were blocked because this session's web-search budget (200/200) was already exhausted before I could use it — a fresh scout with search budget available should retry `site:github.com "hotel reit" revpar market csv`, `site:github.com bonvoy OR honors OR "world of hyatt" members dataset`, and `site:github.com marriott hilton development pipeline units`. Best path forward for this KPI (peer hotel RevPAR/pipeline/loyalty as a demand-strength read-through for ABNB) is almost certainly generic SEC EDGAR full-text/XBRL tooling (already flagged as gap #15 territory) pointed at the specific hotel REIT and C-corp tickers, rather than a purpose-built GitHub dataset — flag that combination to whichever scout covers gap #15 (SEC EDGAR/XBRL tooling) or #8 (hotel supply/demand).
